capture.notes: Live Legrand/BTicino MyHomeServer1 (firmware 3.87.13 / WHO 13 device type 200 / WHO 1013 67.15.5.0, identified in myhomeserver1_live_2026-10-24) WHO 4 capture of 2026-10-25, 10:46-11:02 UTC, recorded with OWNd master on the same large home plant as myhomeserver1_live_2026-10-24 (WHO 4 zones 35-70, actuators Z#1 on 34 zones, fan coils Z#2 on five, zone-0 pumps 0#1..0#4, humidity probes on 17 zones). Status reads only, no command. Purpose: the per-zone actuator, valve, fan-speed and humidity reads behind MyHOME pull request 792 (actuator status at startup, hvac_action from dimension 20) and 793 (humidity gate) on a second gateway family, next to the F461 capture f461_actuators_live_2026-10-25: *#13**16## and *#13**0##, *#4*#0*20## (the all-zones actuator request), then for every zone 35..70 *#4*Z*19##, *#4*Z*20##, *#4*Z*11## and *#4*Z*60##, then *#4*0*60##, then a 600 s listen with the house's own WHO 4 and WHO 1 traffic and the gateway clock broadcasts. Every actuator reported off (0 / fan 5) at capture time; no actuator was on. Sessions: one probe with its own command and event session (mhs1_actuators_reads.jsonl); the probe waited 1.2 s after each request and 1 s between zones. Timing: t is one monotonic axis over the four runs (capture.runs[].t_offset is each run's first row); tx.t is reconstructed from the probe record (record time - 1.2 s pause - reply_time_s) and result.t = tx.t + reply_time_s; command-session rx rows carry t_estimated = true because the session hands the replies over as a batch with the ACK / NACK, so they are placed at their request's t; result.events_after holds only the event-session frames that arrived while the request was pending (tx.t <= t <= result.t). The MAC and LAN address in the gateway block are synthetic; no WHO 13 dimension 12 frame was exchanged. The firmware oracle emulates MyHomeServer1 2.82.06; this unit runs 3.87.13.

runs.purpose: *#13**16## (3.87.13), *#13**0## (echoed on the event session), then *#4*#0*20##: ACKed in 0.5 s with 8 replies on the command session while the event session received the whole burst (34 Z#1, 5 Z#2 fan coils at 5, the pumps 0#1..0#4; some zones twice); every actuator off

for each zone 35..70, one at a time: *#4*Z*19## (ACK on 34 zones, NACK after 2.1 s on 54 and 56), *#4*Z*20## (ACK 34 / NACK 2, the five fan-coil zones answer Z#2 then Z#1), *#4*Z*11## (NACK after 2.1 s on all 36: the fan-speed dimension is refused on a valve zone, as the F461's heating-season NACK in f461_live_2026-10-15), *#4*Z*60## (ACK on the 17 zones with a humidity probe, NACK after 2.1 s on 19); the house's spontaneous frames meanwhile (valve reports *#4*Z#1*#20*0## / *#4*Z#1*20*0##, a pump call *4*4002#64*0#4##, the 12:50 clock)
*#4*0*60##: ACKed in 0.66 s, the 17 zones with a probe answer on both sessions (8 of them collected on the command session)

600 s listen with no request pending: the house's own WHO 4 traffic (temperatures, dimension 7 setpoints, 12 / 14 / 13 and season frames of a periodic zone sweep, dimension 5, humidity), four valve off reports, WHO 1 light frames and the 13:00 clock broadcast
